title: Default
summary: The built-in PLVS profile for sound design, game-audio development, and everyday game testing.
descriptionMarkdown: Default is the built-in PLVS working profile for sound design, game-audio development, and everyday game testing. It keeps −23 LUFS as a familiar professional reference while using broad monitoring bounds for varied material. Momentary above −6 LUFS and Short-term above −12 LUFS warn so the Loudness panel visibly demonstrates its rule colors; Integrated outside −30 to −16 LUFS and LRA above 18 LU also warn, while True Peak above −1 dBTP fails. This is a flexible monitoring baseline and product demonstration, not a delivery standard.
